definitions.explanation: A narrative, especially a traditional or fictional one.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{昔|むかし}{話|ばなし}の{物語|ものがたり}を{読|よ}んであげた。
examples.english: I read a folktale story to the child.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{実話|じつわ}に{基|もと}づいた{物語|ものがたり}だ。
examples.english: This movie is a story based on a true story.

examples.japanese: 『{源氏|げんじ}{物語|ものがたり}』は{日本|にほん}の{古典|こてん}{文学|ぶんがく}だ。
examples.english: The Tale of Genji is Japanese classical literature.

notes:
USAGE: {物語|ものがたり} often appears in titles of literary works and has a classical, narrative connotation.

FAMOUS WORKS:
・{源氏|げんじ}{物語|ものがたり} (The Tale of Genji)
・{竹取|たけとり}{物語|ものがたり} (The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter)
・{平家|へいけ}{物語|ものがたり} (The Tale of the Heike)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{物語|ものがたり}を{語|かた}る (to tell a story)
・{物語|ものがたり}が{展開|てんかい}する (a story unfolds)
